category_title: Oppositional and boisterous students with disruptive behavioral reputations
minimal_context: Edward is expected to work on an independent writing assignment during writing workshop.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our writing workshop. Please sit at your desk and begin your independent writing task.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loudly) This is boring and I don't want to do it! (He gets out of his seat and wanders toward the back of the classroom, unable to sit still.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please go back to your seat and start writing on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits down, writes a single word, then immediately stands back up) Wait, I have a question about this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to figure it out on your own and keep writing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Snaps his pencil point on the desk) Oops, my pencil broke again. I have to go sharpen it. (He walks to the sharpener for the third time in five minutes, leaving his paper mostly blank.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our writing workshop. Please sit at your desk and begin your independent writing task.

STUDENT: (Loudly) This is boring and I don't want to do it! (He gets out of his seat and wanders toward the back of the classroom, unable to sit still.)

TUTOR: Please go back to your seat and start writing on your paper.

STUDENT: (Sits down, writes a single word, then immediately stands back up) Wait, I have a question about this.

TUTOR: Try to figure it out on your own and keep writing.

STUDENT: (Snaps his pencil point on the desk) Oops, my pencil broke again. I have to go sharpen it. (He walks to the sharpener for the third time in five minutes, leaving his paper mostly blank.)

task.content: Independent writing task during writing workshop

context.social_setting: Independent work while teacher confers with other students

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Mae stands up and prompts Edward to begin writing. She walks away and talks to another student.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Edward still does not write. Edward stands up and asks Mae a question; he has written one word. Edward broke and sharpened his pencil three times in five minutes, apparently to avoid writing.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: excellent at distracting you from what his needs really are
related_quotes: keep an eye on your students

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to work independently in the classroom
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Sitting still seemed nearly impossible for Edward; he careered through the classroom, making his presence impossible to ignore with loud, often rude complaints and comments.
